Keep it real.

Pretending isn't really our thing. Stay true with no filters, no façades—just unmatched comfort that's as real as the beans in our brews.

Details

  • Black long sleeve pocket tee with a red Death Wish Coffee Co. wordmark printed at the left chest and Death Wish Coffee logo at the back.
  • Custom woven DWC tab at the hip.

Care Instructions

  • Hand or machine wash cold with like colors.
  • Tumble dry low.
  • Do not bleach.
  • Do not iron decorations.
